history.query: what is the average budget per movie genre
history.insight: The computed result shows a wide range of average budgets across different movie genres, with some genres like Action and Action|Adventure|Science Fiction having significantly higher budgets. Notably, the average budget for Action|Adventure|Crime is the highest at 245 million dollars, while Thriller|Mystery has one of the lowest at 5 million dollars. A practical takeaway from this data is that movie producers should carefully consider the genre of their film when allocating budget, as some genres tend to require more investment than others to be successful.
